status: Record of the existing production transport; does not promote or rebuild the frozen producer sources in this repository.

transport.message_framing: Exactly one complete 240-byte packet per message; reject truncation, oversized records and a version/bytes mismatch.

fields.name: flags
fields.meaning: Transport/source-presence flags; never OpenXR relation flags.

fields.name: sample_monotonic_ns
fields.meaning: Bounded conversion of the gyro sample timestamp when CLOCK is present.

fields.name: gyro
fields.meaning: Real external-SDK-axis input, copied without a runtime-coordinate conversion.

fields.name: accel
fields.meaning: Real external-SDK-axis input, copied without a runtime-coordinate conversion.

fields.name: rotation_xyzw
fields.meaning: Raw vendor quaternion in x,y,z,w order; runtime mapping is separate.

fields.name: translation
fields.meaning: Raw vendor translation; presence is not physical position acceptance.

fields.name: pose_quality
fields.meaning: Raw vendor quality, not an Xr validity bit.

fields.name: tracking_state
fields.meaning: Raw vendor tracking state, widened from the source record u16.

fields.name: warning_flags
fields.meaning: Raw vendor warning bits, widened from the source record u16.

fields.name: pose_index
fields.meaning: Published pose-ring index; must be below 80 when RAW_POSE is present.

fields.name: reserved
fields.meaning: All three elements must be zero.

known_flags.name: A081_TRACKING_IMU
known_flags.meaning: Real IMU input is present; required by the existing transport client.

known_flags.name: A081_TRACKING_CLOCK
known_flags.meaning: The producer obtained a bounded BOOTTIME-to-MONOTONIC sample conversion.

known_flags.name: A081_TRACKING_RAW_POSE
known_flags.meaning: A coherent raw vendor pose record with matching gyro timestamp was copied; not proof of valid tracking quality.

known_flags.name: A081_TRACKING_CAMERA_SUBMITTED
known_flags.meaning: The producer recorded a camera submission; consumers must independently check freshness and pose validity.

oem_prediction_tail.coherence: All six vectors are copied from the same 192-byte record as quaternion, translation, timestamp, quality and state. The producer compares the published index before/after and compares two record copies before setting RAW_POSE.
oem_prediction_tail.semantics: Raw OEM prediction coefficients, preserved verbatim in wire order. Interpretation and prediction timing belong to the explicit runtime consumer; this contract adds no prediction or coordinate transform.
oem_prediction_tail.forbidden_substitution: Do not extend a v1 packet with invented, extrapolated or zero-filled coefficients and advertise it as a real v2 producer packet.

existing_transport_client_checks: Receive with MSG_TRUNC and require exactly 240 bytes, matching magic, version=2 and bytes=240.
Require nonzero session_id and sequence; reject any flags outside 0x0f; require IMU.
Require nonzero gyro/accel BOOTTIME timestamps, accel <= gyro and gyro-accel <= 100000000 ns.
Require finite gyro and accel vectors, all reserved words zero and pose_read_status <= 4.
If CLOCK is set, require nonzero sample_monotonic_ns <= send_monotonic_ns and clock_bracket_ns <= 50000.
If RAW_POSE is set, require pose_read_status=1, pose_index < 80 and pose_boottime_ns=gyro_boottime_ns.
These transport checks do not replace downstream packet-age, raw-quality, quaternion, camera-age, prediction-coefficient or coordinate/physical validity gates.

compatibility_boundary.rule: The common field prefix does not make the versioned protocols interchangeable. Current v2 clients must consume the existing v2 source contract; rebuilding old producer sources against their unchanged v1 header does not produce v2.
